requires.hardware: Python 3.11+ for the dense reference; C++20 standard library and 32-bit IEEE float for native CPU storage and arithmetic

contract.input: Finite FP32 KV/query values, geometry/capacities, logical query rows, explicit RoPE positions/frequencies, optional masks/bias, exact tokens and complete representation identity
contract.output: Packed attention values/logsumexp over block-table views of StateCache sequences; all-masked rows produce zero/-inf
contract.ownership: StatePages or EncodedPages hold the rows; Core's StateCache owns which sequence references which page. Views and plans copy a block table and own no pages: pages a sequence releases stay readable until retire() covers the releasing epoch, so device adapters retire only after physical completion. A later round of the same sequence may overwrite an unshared tail past a rewind. Attention plans read one KV image and own private scratch; input/mask spans and synchronous GEMM providers remain live through run, with no simultaneous workspace reuse. Batch plans retain every request view and private workspace; input permutation is resolved by request/generation identity. One batch rejects concurrent or reentrant execution.
contract.failure: Reject invalid geometry/domain, nonfinite rows (before StateCache::begin, so nothing changes), rows outside a page and empty attention; StateCache rejects capacity, stale ids and invalid commit/rewind. Native attention rejects nonfinite scores/results. Tiled attention validates strides, masks and scratch admission; cancellation or failed/incomplete GEMM returns no partial result and leaves KV unchanged. Batch identity validation precedes arithmetic; aggregate request/query/workspace/output/metadata limits apply and no partial batch result escapes a failure.
contract.core_boundary: Core owns request/resource/lifetime policy and all KV page/sequence/round/copy-on-write/prefix bookkeeping and retirement (crit/state.h StateCache). Inference keeps only storage formats (StatePages FP32, EncodedPages G32 int8, both StateStorage implementations) and attention math. The engine reserves the arena, calls StateCache from one thread and supplies model arithmetic and physical completion.

validation.host: Python fixtures retain the dense transaction/formula example; native StatePages fixtures cover row staging, partial commit, discard, rewind, fork copy-on-write, prefix reuse through StateCache, rejected rows and 5000 randomized transitions against a value oracle
validation.native: StatePages fixtures plus 2304 independent dense-reference attention cases, RoPE/prefill/decode/COW comparisons, varied continuation chunks and shared-prefix boundaries around page edges, cancellation, extreme logits and failed kernels; optional retained OpenBLAS profile repeats numerical/integration checks. Device fences and full-model behavior remain unqualified; native encoded KV fixture covers packed storage accounting, StateCache COW, rollback/rewind, invalid append, capacity rejection and generic attention against decoded KV; ragged batch fixture adds 74 dense comparisons, mixed geometry, permuted/stale/duplicate identities, aggregate limits, cancellation/reentrancy and later-row failure; encoded batch identity/results and 24 Core synthetic dense-generation comparisons on Core's StateCache with StatePages, plus a fork copy-on-write check
validation.performance: No engine throughput/latency claim; page sharing and workspace bounds are functional properties, and synchronous CPU GEMM provider speed requires workload-specific measurement
